title: Senior AI / Agent Developer | Bolt Careers
content:
**About Bolt**

Bolt is shaping a future where cities are built for people, not cars. What started as an ambitious project of a 19-year-old in 2013 has grown into a global mobility platform used by more than 200 million customers and 4.5 million driver and courier partners across 50 countries.

From ride-hailing and food delivery to scooters, e-bikes, and car-sharing, Bolt helps people move through cities every day. Small, autonomous teams drive this work, combining the speed and ownership of a startup with the scale of a global technology company backed by more than €1bn in funding.

And we're just getting started.

**Why join Bolt?**

* Build the future of mobility and help transform how people live and move in cities.
* Tackle challenges at scale that span technology, operations, regulation, and growth.
* Take real ownership early. Small, lean teams mean your decisions matter from day one, and you'll learn fast alongside some of the best people in the industry.
* Join one of Europe's leading technology companies, backed by world-class investors including Sequoia.

**About the role**

Join Bolt as a Senior AI/Agent Engineer to build production AI agents that take real action across our People systems. This is a newly formed team, so you'll be setting the patterns rather than inheriting them. You'll transform complex processes spanning HRIS, ATS, performance, payroll, goals, learning, and data systems into safe, scalable, and reliable workflows. Your work will reduce manual effort and make critical People processes faster, more reliable, and easier to scale.

As the Senior Engineer on the agentic side of the team, you'll own systems end to end — from solution design through evaluation, reliability, and production operation — and set the patterns the rest of the team builds on. You'll work closely with Integration and Analytics Engineers to define the tool contracts and data requirements your agents depend on, while mentoring engineers and contributing strong engineering patterns. As these systems handle sensitive employee data and employment-related processes, you'll apply a particularly high bar for correctness, auditability, safety, and human oversight.

**Main tasks and responsibilities:**

* Owning the full lifecycle of production AI agents and LLM-powered automation — from requirements and solution design through implementation, automated testing and evaluations, release, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.
* Designing agents that safely take action across People systems, including tool contracts, input validation, scoped permissions, idempotency, retries, rollback strategies, and appropriate human-in-the-loop approval gates.
* Building reliable agentic workflows, multi-step LLM pipelines, and retrieval solutions using event-driven architecture and the orchestration patterns and integration standards adopted by the team.
* Establishing evaluation, observability, and safety practices for your agents, including regression suites, production

# Tartu

Welcome to Tartu, a vibrant student city where everything is within walking distance.

Come and join Pipedrive’s Tartu team!

## About us

Pipedrive’s Tartu office opened in 2015 and is now home to one of our four engineering hubs, along with Tallinn, Prague and Lisbon. With 60+ employees representing more than 10 nationalities, we’re a tight-knit team with big ideas and even bigger energy.

While Pipedrive has grown into Estonia’s fifth unicorn, the culture in Tartu still carries the spirit of our early startup days – where creativity, humor and collaboration lead the way.  
Sure, their jokes are hilarious, but don’t let that fool you: “Tartu delivers” is this office’s motto, for a reason. The winning teams at our hackathons often come from here and the quality of their work speaks for itself.

Over the years, we’ve been recognized with multiple best employer awards in Estonia, but what makes this office truly special is its people. Whether you're a seasoned engineer or just starting your career, you'll find the space and support you need to thrive here.

## Our traditions

We like to keep things down to earth and fun. Whether that’s sharing self-organized lunches, competing in a bake-off, or cheering each other on during a Lightning Talk (where employees get to hone their presentation skills on a topic of their choice), there’s always something happening.

Each month, we come together for different activities – from sauna nights, board game battles and gaming tournaments to hiking, biking and even winter swimming. We’ve got a strong gaming culture, a love for the outdoors and a great sense of humor that ties it all together.

We also host our own version of Pipehikes, inspired by our team in Lisbon, and open the office doors to our little ones during PipeKids – an annual afternoon of creativity and play for employees’ families.  
 And at the end of the year, we join Pipedrivers around the world for our winter holiday celebration: an in-house award show full of recognition, fun sketches and community spirit, dubbed “The Pipeys”.

Whether you're leading a talk, jumping into a tournament or just relaxing in the sauna, there’s a place for you here.

Our Tartu office is located near the city center in the city’s first LEED Gold-certified office building – a modern, energy-efficient tower that reflects our commitment to a thoughtful work environment. ## Role

Everything our users see runs on Next.js and React, and we'd like to hand it to you: the design system it's built from, how fast it loads, and whether everyone can actually use it.

You'll work closely with our software architects, product owners, and fellow developers: code reviews, pair programming, and the technical decisions that stick around.

## Your mission

* You build and maintain our design system in React and Tailwind, so features stay consistent instead of being rebuilt from scratch each time.
* You own frontend performance in Next.js 16 — rendering strategy, bundle size, and what people actually experience on a mediocre connection.
* You treat accessibility as a default, not as cleanup at the end of the sprint.
* You develop the Node.js layer (Express.js, Nest.js) between the UI and our backend services, with Redis where caching helps.
* You push for clean code and automated testing, and you share what you know instead of sitting on it.
* You use coding agents as part of your daily workflow — directing their work, reviewing their output, and fixing what doesn't hold up. Writing code matters; knowing what good code looks like matters more.

## Your profile

* You've spent several years building production frontends with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
* You know Tailwind CSS well and you've managed client-side state with Zustand.
* You test what you build — unit and component tests with Vitest, end-to-end tests with Playwright.
* You're comfortable in Node.js with Express.js or Nest.js, and working against APIs from a microservices backend.
* You work well in agile teams (Scrum/Kanban), you write clearly, and you're comfortable in English.
* You have a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or the experience that makes one unnecessary.

## Nice to have

* You've worked with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. We're not in the cloud yet, so this is a plus, not a requirement.

## How you think

We care as much about how you approach a problem as about which frameworks you know. You look past the edges of your own ticket: you notice when a fix really belongs in a different service, you question a process once it has stopped making sense, and you judge your work by whether the whole system got better — not by whether your part shipped. "Not my code" isn't a sentence we use much around here.
